storylines.title: Iran War
storylines.overview: The Iran War is a sustained international conflict centered on Iran, the United States and Israel, with military, maritime, economic and diplomatic consequences across the Persian Gulf and neighboring states. U.S. combat operations began on February 28, 2026, and security in the Strait of Hormuz has remained one of the conflict's central pressure points.
storylines.current_status: The United States conducted airstrikes on Iranian rocket launchers located on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, marking the first military action in weeks. The strikes reportedly targeted Iranian forces preparing to deploy sea mines into the strategic waterway. The attack resulted in two fatalities and two injuries. In response, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps warned of a potential retaliatory response.
